'''Brigadier General''' was a a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]]. [[Meebur Gascon]] aspired to be promoted Brigadier General of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Brigadier General [[Nevar/Legends|Nevar]] served the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The [[Etahn A'baht]] from the [[Dornean Navy]] was a Brigadier General who served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], being addressed as "General A'baht." [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Horn]] was a Brigadier General in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] during the battle against [[Abeloth]].
